title: Figma Plugin Phase 7 - Full Registry Integration
overview: Ensure all Figma generators derive styling values from component-registry.json for automatic sync with code changes. Add COMPONENT_STYLING_METADATA for components with hardcoded dimensions.

context.problem: 5 generators have hardcoded SIZE_CONFIG/dimension objects that duplicate values from React components. When React components change, Figma generators drift out of sync.
context.current_state: Phase 6 eliminated ~95% of magic numbers via shared.ts constants. However, 5 generators still have hardcoded config objects (DateRangePicker, Pagination, InputArea, LayerCard, MenuBar) that should derive from the registry.
context.why_now: Phase 6 (magic numbers audit) is COMPLETE. This phase addresses the remaining architectural gap for full Figma-code sync capability.

/**
 * Dropdown Component Generator
 *
 * INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE: Figma variants differ from React variants
 *
 * React Component Variants:
 * - variant: "default" | "danger"
 *
 * Figma Display Variants (for demonstration):
 * - default: Basic dropdown menu
 * - withIcons: Menu items with leading icons
 * - withDanger: Menu with destructive option
 * - withGroups: Menu with grouped sections
 * - withCheckbox: Menu with checkable items
 * - withShortcuts: Menu items with keyboard shortcuts
 *
 * The Figma variants show different visual configurations
 * for design exploration, not React component variants.
 */
